fee_notes: $50,000 for Cleaning Facility; $20,000 for Retail Store. Development Rights Fee of $50,000/Cleaning Facility and $20,000/Retail Store credited against Initial Franchise Fee. Partial refund (up to 60% for Cleaning Facility, up to 50% for Retail Store) if franchisee fails Initial Training Program.
raw_excerpt: You are required to pay us an initial franchise fee of $50,000 for each Cleaning Facility and $20,000 for each Retail Store due and payable when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
